steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Thuy Long, a water element dragon, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: sniffing the food; (3) EAT: sucking the food in with a water swirl; (4) EAT: chewing happily. Row 2: (5) EAT: blowing a happy water bubble; (6) PLAY: coiling its tail; (7) PLAY: leaping in an arc; (8) PLAY: swimming through the air with a water ribbon. Row 3: (9) PLAY: spinning inside a water spiral; (10) PLAY: landing with a splash; (11) PLAY: shooting a water fountain upward happily; (12) REFUSE food: turning its head and puffing water. Row 4: (13) PETTED: purring, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving a little claw; (15) SAD: curled up, crying droplets; (16) ANGRY: water spouting from its nose.
